verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a search/retrieval API, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Exa as a hosted, pay-as-you-go API that calls api.exa.ai with an API key. The open-source MCP server is a thin wrapper around that hosted API, not a self-hostable search index or engine, so it earns no credit toward self-hosting the core product.
